name: Nghe An Legacy Marathon 2026
short_description: Nghe An Legacy Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Binh Minh Square in Cua Lo, Nghe An, over 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Nghe An Legacy Marathon 2026, subtitled "Dau chan que Bac", is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Binh Minh Square in Cua Lo, Nghe An. It is organised by Zaha Vietnam JSC and offers 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km. The organisers describe a wide, flat course through the home province of President Ho Chi Minh.

faqs.question: How much does Nghe An Legacy Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: Prices rise through five tiers. The 42 km goes from 438,000 VND in the July flash sale to 900,000 VND in the late tier (11 to 26 November), and the 21 km from 337,000 to 800,000 VND. Transfers cost 250,000 VND, while personal-detail and distance changes are free.

faqs.question: What are the age limits at Nghe An Legacy Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Both the 42 km full marathon and the 21 km half marathon are open to runners aged 16 and over. The 10 km is open from age 12 and the 5 km from age five. Personal details can be changed until 26 November 2026, and moving up a distance means paying the difference.
